# Load metrics
```{r}
metrics <- read.csv("/data/akalin/akollot/anglemania_benchmark/simulated/metrics/combined_metrics.tsv", sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
head(metrics)
colnames(metrics)
samplesheet <- read.csv("/local/Projects/AAkalin_Neuroblastoma/Results/simulate_single_cell/samplesheet.tsv", sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
samplesheet <- samplesheet %>%
  filter(ngroup <= 4, nbatch <= 5)
colnames(samplesheet)

metrics <- metrics %>%
  left_join(samplesheet %>% select(-original_h5ad), by = join_by(sample == sample_name))

# metrics["Batch"] = metrics[["ASW_label/batch", "PCR_batch", "graph_conn"]].mean(axis=1)
# metrics["Bio"] = metrics[["ASW_label", "isolated_label_silhouette"]].mean(axis=1)
bio_metrics <- c("cLISI", "ARI_cluster.label", "NMI_cluster.label", "ASW_label", "isolated_label_F1", "isolated_label_silhouette")
batch_metrics <- c("kBET", "ASW_label.batch", "iLISI")

# calculate weighted mean with 0.6 for bio and 0.4 for batch
# first min max scale every metrics
#metrics_scaled = (metrics - metrics.min()) / (metrics.max() - metrics.min())
min_max_norm <- function(x) {
    (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
  }

metrics_scaled <- metrics %>%
  # scale data
  mutate(across(all_of(bio_metrics), ~ min_max_norm(.) %>% as.vector), .by = integration_method) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(batch_metrics), ~ min_max_norm(.) %>% as.vector), .by = integration_method) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    bio_score = mean(c_across(all_of(bio_metrics))),
    batch_score = mean(c_across(all_of(batch_metrics))),
    overall_score = 0.6 * bio_score + 0.4 * batch_score
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

View(metrics_scaled)
colnames(metrics_scaled)
```


```{r}

p <- metrics_scaled %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = batch.facLoc, y = de.facLoc))+
  geom_tile(aes(fill = overall_score))+
  facet_wrap(~gene_selection+integration_method)
p

p <- metrics_scaled %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = de.facLoc, y = overall_score))+
  geom_point(aes(color = batch.facLoc, shape = gene_selection))+
  facet_wrap(~gene_selection+integration_method)
p

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.8)

for (i in unique(metrics_scaled$ngroup)) {
  for (j in unique(metrics_scaled$nbatch)) {
    print(metrics_scaled %>% 
      filter(ngroup == i, nbatch == j) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(de.facLoc), y = overall_score))+
      # geom_point(aes(color = batch.facLoc, shape = gene_selection))+
        geom_violin(aes(fill = as.factor(gene_selection)), position = dodge)+
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, position = dodge,  aes(fill = as.factor(gene_selection))) +
        facet_wrap(~integration_method, ncol = 1)+
        ggtitle(paste0("ngroup: ", i, ", nbatch: ", j)))

  }
}

p <- metrics_scaled %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(de.facLoc), y = overall_score))+
  geom_violin(aes(fill = gene_selection), position = dodge)+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, aes(fill = gene_selection), position = dodge) +
  facet_wrap(~integration_method, ncol = 1)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
p
```

```{r}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)
p <- metrics_scaled %>% 
  filter(integration_method == "scvi",
         ngroup ==2,
         nbatch == 5)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(de.facLoc), y = overall_score))+
  # geom_violin(aes(fill = gene_selection), position = dodge, width = 2)+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, aes(fill = gene_selection), position = dodge) +
  geom_jitter(aes(fill = gene_selection), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.7)) +
  # make manual color
  # scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") +  # "Paired" is a good palette for qualitative factors
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Biological Variability", y = "Integration Score") +
  #increase font size of all text
  theme(text = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
  aspect.ratio = 1,
  legend.position = c(0.7,0.2))
p

```

metrics_scaled %>%
